Over time, Alex watches more foot massage videos and begins to develop a growing interest in feet. This interest could be considered a foot fetish, as it is an unusual and intense attraction to a part of the body that is not typically considered sexually attractive.

The development of this foot fetish can be explained through classical conditioning, a learning process that pairs a neutral stimulus (feet in this case) with an unconditioned stimulus (pleasure from the foot massage).
